roster.name: Amazon
roster.note: public search.json, full-text over the posting body; endpoint reused from unifier-jobs where it was live-verified 2026-07-30. Amazon's NYC finance org (Ads, Prime Video, Devices) is the densest single source of in-range Finance Manager / Sr Finance Manager roles on this roster.

roster.name: Meta
roster.note: graphql CPJobSearchSourceQuery; doc_id + request shape reused from unifier-jobs (captured 2026-07-17, long-lived but can rotate — a rotation shows up as a fail_streak health warning, not silent zeroes).

roster.name: Google
roster.note: unifier-jobs monitored Google via a generic_page keyword check, which is useless here (every careers page contains the word "finance"). Probe round 1 (2026-08-10) ruled out both v3 search shapes: careers.google.com /api/v3/search returned 404 JSON and the www.google.com/about/careers /applications/api/v3/search path returned a 404 HTML page. Round 6 mapped what IS available: the results HTML does carry real job data (17 finance hits, 15 job-id links for an FP&A query), but the job links have NO anchor text, so titles aren't recoverable from the results page, and the detail pages carry no ld+json — the title is only in <title> and the body text is unstructured. So Google is implementable as "extract ids from results HTML, then fetch and scrape each detail page", at roughly 15 detail fetches of ~1.1MB per query. That is 10-20x the cost of every other adapter here and it is HTML-shape-brittle, so it is a deliberate not-yet rather than a dead end. DECLINED by the owner 2026-08-11 on cost — not money (public repo, unlimited Actions minutes) but runtime and brittleness. Do NOT build this without asking again.

roster.note: cxs endpoint reused from unifier-jobs (verified 2026-07-30, inventory 2000). Workday searchText is fuzzy — expect unrelated hits that the function/seniority gates drop. That is noise, not breakage.

roster.name: Apple
roster.note: needs a custom adapter — jobs.apple.com posts to its own search-reference API (csrf token required). Not a Workday/Greenhouse shape.

roster.name: Microsoft
roster.note: Microsoft runs Eightfold, found sideways in probe round 5 — its documented gcsservices.careers.microsoft.com API fails TLS from the Actions runner (SSLError on every attempt), but the jobs host served an Eightfold app shell. SETTLED 2026-08-11, do not spend more rounds here: round 7 read the real config out of that shell — the API is Eightfold's MULTI-TENANT host, app.eightfold.ai with domain=microsoft.com, not any microsoft.com path (which is why every microsoft.com URL returned the SPA shell). Round 8 then found app.eightfold.ai answers 403 to every header combination tried (browser UA, +Referer, +Origin, adapter UA) while a CONTROL call to explore.jobs.netflix.net succeeded in the same run — so it is tenant-level blocking of non-browser callers, not our egress and not a wrong path. Microsoft needs real browser automation, which a daily cron can't do. Use config/seed_jobs.yaml to add a Microsoft role by hand if one matters.

roster.name: Netflix
roster.note: Eightfold, verified in probe round 4 (count=16 for a finance query) and its payload mapped in round 5: the list endpoint returns an EMPTY job_description, so the adapter must fetch the per-job detail call — a list-only implementation would have shipped every Netflix role with no text to score. Round 6 ran the real adapter end-to-end: inventory 485, full descriptions on every record. Expect most hits to be Los Angeles or overseas — the location gate drops them, which is correct, not breakage.

roster.name: Uber

roster.name: Spotify

roster.name: LinkedIn
roster.note: careers.linkedin.com only. NOT to be scraped via linkedin.com job search — see CLAUDE.md rule 3 (account-ban risk). Leave disabled unless a non-LinkedIn-domain endpoint is found.

roster.name: Oracle

roster.name: Accenture
roster.note: reused from unifier-jobs. Their cxs endpoint is intermittently flaky (returns HTML instead of JSON some hours) — treat fail_streaks of 3 or fewer as flakiness, not breakage. Categorised advertising because Accenture Song is the owner's adjacent-industry route, but its corporate finance org is the actual target here.

roster.name: Publicis Groupe
roster.note: probe round 1 (2026-08-10): the postings API answers 200 with totalFound=0 for PublicisGroupe, Publicis, Havas and dentsu alike, so a 200 here does not mean the token is right — an unknown company returns an empty result, not a 404. Read the real token off a live SmartRecruiters apply URL before enabling. The adapter itself is proven (built for Turner & Townsend in unifier-jobs).

roster.name: WPP
roster.note: holdco careers page is a brochure. WPP hires through its operating companies (GroupM, Ogilvy, VML, Hogarth, Burson), each with its own ATS — so this is 5+ endpoints, not one. Deferred; expand only if the board is thin.

roster.name: Omnicom

roster.name: Dentsu
roster.note: Workday tenant dentsuaegis, site DAN_GLOBAL — read off the real handoff link on dentsu.com/careers in probe round 5 after seven guessed site names all returned 400. This is also the roster's biggest source of client/commercial-finance noise, which is exactly what exclude.title_terms is for.
